qk_vs_ov_reading: Again mlp1 dominates by ~1000x over any head. Head 8.7 is the (tiny) top head at both grains, with ov (0.0057) close to qk (0.0044) -- ratio 1.3, i.e. mostly SELECTION, not a distinctive payload -- but its absolute size is negligible next to mlp1 (5.90) and mlp3 (2.15). No head here matches the known 8.1/8.3 circuits; this is a different, much weaker head (8.7) contributing almost nothing to the prediction.
category_story: mlp1 is a giant front token-table keyed on the current token's surface identity/spelling: it fires hardest on subword/compound continuations that are near-deterministic given the current token alone -- completing a word split across BPE tokens (e.g. 'six-re'->'actor', 'epitom'->'izes', 'BRU'->'CE', 'TOGET'->'HER'), repeated legal-boilerplate compounds (e.g. 'Transferor'/'Transferee'->' spouse'), and form-filler boilerplate ('Yes___No__'->'____'). Its scope is 'the next BPE fragment of an in-progress multi-token word or fixed phrase', not context-dependent selection at all.
surprises: '4-' -> 'H' (completing the fixed organization name '4-H') is exactly the kind of subword/compound-completion event the mlp1 scope-scan turns up as its top examples (e.g. 'six-re'->'actor'), confirming the category story on a fresh case not in the original top-25 list. mlp3 (2.15 dCE) is a nontrivial secondary contributor here, unlike in datapoint 0, suggesting mlp3 may pick up some of the same token-identity work as a backup/refinement to mlp1 specifically for rarer compound tokens.
